audio.file: inputs/The Vibe Coding song (一笔一画).mp3
audio.time_base: seconds from the first decoded sample (what an NLE shows); MP3 start_time 0.023 s encoder delay is trimmed by the decoder

tempo.measured: smooth accelerando: 140.2 BPM at 0:00 -> 143.5 (0:51) -> 146.0 (1:24) -> 149.3 (1:57) -> 151.1 (2:45) -> 152.3 BPM (3:01); then rubato outro (~137 BPM nominal, no drums) 187.0-194.1, synth pulse ~134 BPM 194.1-197.6, final tag ~141 BPM.
tempo.feel: trap half-time: kick on 1, snare on 3 of each 4-beat bar at the 140-level; a "half-time pulse" = every other beat.
tempo.warning: Do NOT use a fixed 140 BPM grid: by 3:00 it would be ~5 beats (~2 s) early. Use beat_grid below.

beat_grid.convention: 4/4 at the ~140-152 BPM level; bar 1 beat 1 = first downbeat at 0.343 s; zone=measured (drum-onset anchored spline), nominal_rubato (no pulse, evenly spaced placeholder), measured_outro.

sections.name: Intro A
sections.description: Synth pad + sparse kicks; 4-note whistle hook (0.90-3.75); shouted "Paint it, run it, ship it!" (4.21-6.91) with drum stabs on the words; no bass.

sections.name: Intro B
sections.description: 808 bass enters 7.01 (bar 5 hit 7.18); whistle hook 2nd phrase (7.60-10.62, ~1.18 kHz); breathy "一笔 一画" (11.12-12.86) + high melisma tail to 13.82.

sections.name: Verse 1
sections.description: Full trap groove (kick 14.025); sultry low lead (B3-D4). Instrument stops under vocal at 16.73-17.38 and 23.70-24.20; stutter gaps 29.2-30.8; Mandarin lines from 27.80.

sections.name: Pre-Chorus
sections.description: Lift: chopped stops 35.88-36.89 (several 0.1-0.2 s cuts), vocal climbs to A4/B4 on 来 (40.1-41.6).

sections.name: Chorus 1
sections.description: Belted English hook; instrumental stop 43.89-44.45 under "read"; "Oh oh oh" run 59.45-61.25; held "there" to ~67.9.

sections.name: Chorus 1 tag / build (snare roll -> silence)
sections.description: Drums thin out, synths swell (other stem +6 dB); chant 一切从这里出发 72.13; hats/snare densify into triplet roll 77.76-79.4; chant 一笔一画 79.36; last hit ~79.64; FULL SILENCE 79.87-80.805 (0.935 s) with only the 画 vocal tail.

sections.name: Post-Chorus Drop 1
sections.description: Hard instrumental chant-drop: drums 80.81 (8th-note anticipation of bar 49 downbeat 81.058), 808 80.99; whistle hook 81.87-86.15; shouted "Fixtures!" (loud 86.87) over stop 87.26-87.81; whistle answer 88.48-89.88; "Functions!" 89.95 then stop 90.375-91.085; "Hey hey hey" pickup 92.56.

sections.name: Verse 2
sections.description: Groove returns; lead from bar 57 downbeat (94.22); 世界 是我的舞台 107.15 over three stutter stops 107.6-109.3.

sections.name: Rap Verse
sections.description: Fast Mandarin rap (10 syllables/s); accent hits on beat 4 of bars 67/69/71/73 (111.66, 114.90, 118.12, 121.34); "Eh eh eh" 112.3, "yeah" 115.6.

sections.name: Bridge (stripped, half-time)
sections.description: Drums/808 drop out 124.5-129.3 (stripped, sultry); drums return ~130 at half-time feel, triplet fill 135.0-136.1; couplet sung twice (123.18 / 129.36).

sections.name: Final Chorus
sections.description: Vocal pickup 135.60; band cuts 137.47-138.90 under "I think about stuff I read", lone hit 138.905, cut again 139.06-139.70, FULL SLAM 139.70; gang-vocal energy; melodic lift (+2 st on "I think...", +7 st on "And everything goes"); no harmonic key change; 16th snare-roll fill 160.9-161.7.

sections.name: Final Chorus tag / build (roll -> silence)
sections.description: Synth swell, 一切从这里出发 165.87; dense 8ths from ~168.1; 一笔一画 172.80; last hit 173.02; FULL SILENCE 173.41-174.00 (0.59 s) with 画 vocal 173.64-174.4 bridging the gap.

sections.name: Post-Chorus Drop 2
sections.description: Biggest drop: drums 174.395 on bar 107 downbeat (174.418), 808 174.62; whistle hook 174.78-179.31; "Fixtures!" loud 180.23 over stop 180.50-181.12; whistle answer 181.12-183.10; "Functions!" 183.07; stop 183.72-184.27; 16th riser 184.3-187.0.

sections.name: Outro
sections.description: Drums out; sustained pad + 808, free-time lead "Everything I love about life just blossoms" (186.70) and "that's it." (191.30/193.20); synth pulse 194.06; tag hit 197.61, micro-silence 197.78-198.03, final drum tag 198.035 (~141 BPM) with processed 一笔一画 chop 199.2-200.8; audio ends ~201.2.

key_gaps.label: beat of silence before Drop 1
key_gaps.note: mix falls to -64 dBFS; only the 画 vocal tail sounds until ~80.85

key_gaps.label: silence before Drop 2
key_gaps.note: drums/synth stop after last hit 173.02; 画 vocal 173.64-174.4 bridges; impact 174.395

key_gaps.label: final-chorus stop 1
key_gaps.note: vocal "I think about stuff I read" continues a cappella-ish

key_gaps.label: outro micro-silence
key_gaps.note: between tag hit 197.61 and final drum tag 198.035

drops.name: Drop 1
drops.note: band re-enters an 8th note before the bar-49 downbeat (anticipation); cut on 80.81-80.86

drops.name: Final Chorus slam
drops.note: slam lands a 16th before beat 2 of bar 85

drops.name: Drop 2
drops.note: on the downbeat; loudest section of the song

snare_rolls_builds.note: hat/snare densify into triplets (bar 47-48), cut ~79.6-79.85 into the silence
16th-note snare roll fill ending the final chorus
16th-note synth riser out of Drop 2 into the outro

key.tonal_center: A (A minor / A Dorian); verses lean on D major (IV), bridge moves E minor -> C -> G -> D before returning to A at 136
key.key_change_evidence: Chroma of harmonic stems (other+bass) Chorus 1 vs Final Chorus correlate r=0.935 at 0 semitones (every other shift r<=0.05); same for drop 1 vs drop 2 (0.932) and build 1 vs build 2 (0.933). The Suno "key-change final chorus" was not realized harmonically.

perceived_lift.what: final chorus vocal pickup after bridge (bridge sits in E minor/G, return to A)
"I think about stuff I read" sung ~+2 semitones higher than chorus 1
"And everything goes from there" sung ~+7 semitones higher (belt) than chorus 1

hooks.note: The whistle-like synth hook (pure ~1.2-2.1 kHz tone) leaks into the demucs vocal stem; it carries the 4-note 一笔一画 motif in the intro and the call/answer phrases in both drops.

energy.note: dB = mean power of 5 ms RMS frames over the bar (dBFS); energy_0_1 = min-max normalized mix level
